name: io.github.gokhancvs/market-fiyati-mcp
description: Unofficial stdio MCP for Turkish grocery prices, branch offers and basket comparisons.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_FIYATI_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Operator-controlled API access; offline blocks all remote price requests. See usage permissions before live access.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_FIYATI_LATITUDE
environmentVariables.description: Default latitude (-90..90). Optional as a group with LONGITUDE and DISTANCE; calls may override the coordinate pair.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_FIYATI_LONGITUDE
environmentVariables.description: Default longitude (-180..180). Set together with MARKET_FIYATI_LATITUDE and MARKET_FIYATI_DISTANCE.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_FIYATI_DISTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Default radius in km (>0..50). Set together with latitude and longitude; no implicit radius.
